title: Lakers JR Smith Responds to Tory Lanez Diss
htmlContent:
On Friday morning Tory Lanez release his new project entitled DayStar and on the fourth track called, ‘Sorry, But I Had To… (feat. Yoko Gold),’ Lanez, revealed that he was taking shots at anyone that mentioned his' name, such as Asian Doll, Jojo, Bun B, Chance The Rapper, and JR Smith.

“JR Smith it’s the pot that piss and you the last cat to talk about some shots that hit,” said Lanez.

“Your performance… plays a role in riding benches N***. I’m in the trenches N***. You the type to buy a chick an 80 inch and won’t get an inch up in her."

This was in response to Smith's comments about Lanez allegedly shooting Megan Thee Stallion in the foot.

“This clown shoots a female and ya’ll listening to his music,” Smith said in a post (h/t TMZ Sports).

Smith would immediately respond to Lanez's jabs.

"I got time today too!" wrote the hoops star, referring to Tory's tweet from earlier in the day. "Bout to get real [spicy]. This clown shoots a female an y'all listening to his music like its ok! Tf @torylanez you a straight [clown] straight [facts] an tell who ever to hit my line it's whatever!"
